verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: I will speak to Aaron and his sons. They shall not profane the sacred places that I have sanctified for them. I, the LORD, will surely do this.
verses.3: Say to your wives, “Every man who comes from your lineage and approaches the sacred objects that the Israelites have set aside for Yahweh, his shame shall be sealed on him. His soul shall be marked by me, Yahweh.”
verses.4: Everyone who is from the descendants of Aaron, and who is unclean or has touched anything that is holy, shall not eat until he is purified. Also, anyone who comes from among them who has been contaminated by any kind of dirt or impurity, shall not eat either.
verses.5: Or someone who suffers all the insults that can be directed at him, or a person who endures all the insults that can be directed towards him.
verses.6: The soul that touches it will be defiled until morning. It will not eat from the sacred things, except by washing its mouth in the water.
verses.7: And the sun came out, and it purified everything. Then it ate from the sacred things, for its meat was pure.
verses.8: I will not allow any of them to eat from it. I am the LORD.
verses.9: And they shall keep my covenant; no sin shall be imposed upon it. It shall not die, for I, the LORD, will sanctify it.
verses.10: And no outsider shall eat the sacred food. The priest and hired servant shall not eat sacred food either.
verses.11: And the priest, when he receives a gift, will eat it and live in his house. They will eat it with their hands.
verses.12: And the daughter of a priest: if she becomes the wife of a foreigner, then she shall not eat anything that is considered sacred.
verses.13: And the priest shall be an impure woman, and she will have no offspring. She shall return to her father’s house, like a virgin. She will eat what her father gives her, but no one else shall eat from it.
verses.14: And a man who eats something that is holy in ignorance, and thereby gains five times as much from it, and gives the offering to the priest.
verses.15: And they shall not defile the sacred objects of the Israelites, those that they have erected for Yahweh.
verses.16: And they shall bring upon them punishment for eating their own offerings, because I, the LORD, have sanctified them.
verses.17: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.18: I spoke to Aaron and his sons, and to all the descendants of Israel. I said to them, “Every man from among the people of Israel, and from among the foreigners living in Israel, who offers his sacrifices to the LORD for all their festivals and ceremonies.”
verses.19: For your sake, let there be a pure memory in the morning, among the dead and the dying.
verses.20: Everything that is dead, do not offer it as sacrifices, for it will not be pleasing to God.
verses.21: And anyone who offers sacrifices of holiness to Jehovah, either in the morning or at noon, with pure animals, will be pleasing to Him. But no one should do so unless it is for a proper purpose.
verses.22: They shall not bring these things before the LORD; neither shall a woman give them as an offering to the LORD.
verses.23: And Shoor Vasheh shall be released, and Kalut Nedava will do that. But Nender will not agree to it.
verses.24: And neither circumcision nor tattooing nor marking or marking with any mark shall be brought before Jehovah. In your land, you shall not do so.
verses.25: And from the time of creation onward, do not offer your bread to your gods. For when they are consumed by them, they will not be pleasing to you.
verses.26: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.27: When a child is born, he remains with his mother for seven days. From the eighth day onward, he wants to bring a woman into Jehovah’s temple.
verses.28: And do not hunt him or his children on the same day.
verses.29: And if you offer sacrifices of thanksgiving to the LORD, then do so in accordance with your desires.
verses.30: On that day, it will be eaten, and no one shall be allowed to eat from it until evening. I am Jehovah.
verses.31: And you have kept My commandments, and you have carried out what I commanded you. As I, the LORD, say.
verses.32: And you shall not profane my holy name. I, the LORD, will make you holy among the children of Israel.
verses.33: I have brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you may become God’s people. I, Jehovah, am your God.
